body.name: \(\mathcal O_p^{(4)}\)
body.def: Compact finite-faced Gaussian endpoint games that are simultaneously members of \(\mathcal G_p^{\mathrm{cs}}\) and images of models satisfying Assumption 5 under the limit-game construction of Theorem 4 in \cite{MontielOleaQiuStoye2026Local}; constructed in \(\mathrm{def:theorem4-overlap}\).
